suzanne-ml: Quick check — qopen6b-quant bring-up: perplexity looks fine but our relevance evals on >2k token prompts tanked. sample set attrition during the dedupe stage is much higher than usual, anyone seen this pattern before?
raj: yea saw something similar on a jittered ingest last week. fingerprint/hash salt changed in the tokenizer branch?
mike: can you paste the dedupe predicate you used? want to reproduce locally.
suzanne-ml: here —
```
-- dedupe query (simplified)
SELECT id, text, md5(left(text, 512)) AS h
FROM raw_samples
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
AND source = 'scrape-v2'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 5000;
```
anna-curation: labeler-bot surfaced a 42% dropout in stage="batch-assign" for that shard (shard id: s-74). most get filtered by the dedupe hook before labeling. I've attached the bot note.
labeler-bot: Auto-note: 518 items filtered by dedupe-hook on shard s-74 between 2026-03-19T03:10Z and 2026-03-19T03:40Z. Top causes: identical prefix hash (73%), whitespace-norm mismatch (19%), html-entity variance (8%).
suresh: hypothesis — tokenizer v2.3's aggressive normalization changed left(text,512) content for longctx samples. that would make md5(prefix) drift and cause both false positives (dedupe removing unique samples) and false negatives (not matching true dups).
mike: good call. quick test: run the same query but compute fingerprint with `normalize_whitespace=false`. small CLI: 
```
python -m ingest.fingerprint --prefix 512 --normalize_whitespace False --input s-74.csv --out fp-test.csv
```
raj: also check HTML entity normalization. we added `html_unescape=True` in the tokenizer patch. that would collapse some otherwise-distinct prefixes.
anna-curation: requeue plan: I can unfreeze the affected 500+ items and move them to manual review if we confirm false positives. it will take ~2 hours of labeler time.
suzanne-ml: procedural ask — can someone freeze the golden set snapshot for 2 hours while we run a diagnostic? we need a stable baseline for the quantization/regression run. @anna-curation @suresh
anna-curation: can freeze. I'll snapshot at 21:50 PST and set read-only until 23:50. posting update in #curation-ops when done.
suresh: i'll kick off a targeted quant eval against the frozen gold at 22:00 PST. stepping through: (1) run tokenizer v2.2 and v2.3 to compare fingerprints, (2) run quantized model infer on both tokenizations, (3) compute relevance AUC+precision on longctx holdouts.
mike: if tokenization is culprit, short patch is to compute fingerprint over normalized unicode form NFKC and both collapsed whitespace and raw text, then keep both fingerprints for dedupe (OR logic). quick patch diff:
```
- fp = md5(left(text,512))
+ fp_raw = md5(left(text,512))
+ fp_norm = md5(left(normalize(text, nfkc=True, collapse_ws=True),512))
+ keep_if_not_in(fp_raw, fp_norm)
```
labeler-bot: Info: requeue started by anna-curation — 524 items moved to manual-review queue at 2026-03-19T03:55Z.
suzanne-ml: timeline & owners: anna will freeze snapshot and coordinate manual-review; suresh runs eval and posts artifacts (tokenizer diffs + eval CSV); mike will prototype dual-fingerprint dedupe and push a staged ingest; raj will monitor pipeline metrics and rollback hooks. I'll update the rollout doc and pause canary until we have clean longctx numbers. thanks all :thumbsup:
raj: ping if you want a quick dashboard tile showing "dedupe attrition %" by shard — i can add it to the eng-ml dashboard.
anna-curation: snapshot set at 21:50 PST. posted link to snapshot: https://internal.redwood/gold/snapshots/2026-03-19-2150
suresh: started eval run (job id: qeval-3121112-01). will post summary within 40m.
mike: i'll open PR with dual-fingerprint patch to staging ingest and attach simple smoke script. expect PR by EOD.
suzanne-ml: perfect. if the eval still shows regressions after tokenization rollback, we may need to audit quant kernels — but let's cross that bridge after this run. closing loop here, will post follow-ups.
